questions.question: Why give an analyst agent only Read, Grep and Glob?
options: It can look but cannot change anything, so it is safe to run unattended
questions.explanation: A closed, read-only tool list is what makes a second opinion trustworthy.

questions.question: An agent finishes. What comes back to your session?
questions.explanation: Subagents work in their own context; only the final message returns. Your context stays clean.

questions.question: In the thesis frame, what is the extra component for?
options: Checking that the other components hand over the right things
questions.explanation: Goal -> tasks -> one component each -> one that checks the hand-offs. The analyst is that checker.

questions.question: Your analyst edited STATUS.md. What went wrong?
options: The tools line includes Edit or Write
questions.explanation: Agents can only use the tools listed. If it edited, the list allowed it.
